object: PREM.HCENT random-centre route and exact charge delta
question: What existing random-centre path is available, and what exact charged delta would replacing lean_attack's deterministic centre incur?
number: attack.c uses rnd_fp254, charged as one random word plus two control operations. lean_attack.c uses uncounted fp_from_u64(ci+1) plus CTL(1). Replacing it costs exactly +2 charged operations per centre and changes the centre distribution; no r2 KAT or independence credit is claimed.
